event: South Korean SA Unemployment Up/Down in November?
frage: Will South Korea's SA Unemployment Rate increase between October and November 2026?
begruendung:
(a) Time left: 28 days until the data is released on December 16, 2026.
(b) Status quo: South Korea's Seasonally Adjusted (SA) unemployment rate for October 2026 was 2.5%.
(c) Broad context: A 2.5% SA unemployment rate is a multi-year low for South Korea. Due to the 0.1% reporting precision, the rate frequently remains flat ("No Change" outcome) month-over-month, doing so roughly 40% of the time in recent years.
(d) Why NO: A declining labor force participation rate mechanically suppresses the unemployment rate, even if hiring softens. Furthermore, the high probability of a "No Change" flat 2.5% outcome acts as a strong headwind against a strict "Up" resolution.
(e) Why YES: Mean reversion from extreme lows is very common; for example, the rate ticked up from 2.6% to 2.7% in late 2025. Reports of slowing job growth and weakness in youth employment suggest structural pressures that could push the rate to 2.6%.
(f) Bets: Factoring in the base rate of mean reversion against the strong historical precedent of month-over-month "No Change," I place the odds of a strict increase slightly below the prediction market price of 57.5%, making me indifferent at 53 cents.
